themes_detail.label: Street Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street conditions in Morrisania/Crotona have spiked dramatically THIS WEEK, with 31 complaints filed compared to a baseline average of 4.9 per week—a 536% increase—suggesting rapid pavement, pothole, or infrastructure failure requiring urgent investigation into whether a specific area or weather event triggered the surge.
evidence: 31 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.36)
536% increase represents one of the highest statistical deviations in recent data
Pattern suggests acute event or failure rather than chronic neglect
reporting_angles: Canvass affected blocks to document specific street failures (potholes, collapses, flooding) and photograph conditions
Interview DOT or city officials about what triggered the spike and timeline for repairs

themes_detail.label: Traffic Signal System Failure
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal complaints surged to 57 THIS LAST WEEK versus a baseline average of 11.9 per week—a 380% spike with z-score of 3.71—indicating potential widespread signal malfunctions that could affect pedestrian and vehicular safety across the district.
evidence: 57 traffic signal condition complaints last week vs. 11.9 weekly average (z-score: 3.71)
380% increase points to coordinated or cascading failure rather than isolated incidents
Safety implications for both vehicle and pedestrian traffic in this area
reporting_angles: Map the 57 complaints to identify if signals are clustered on specific corridors (e.g., Grand Concourse, Third Avenue)
Contact DOT to ask about maintenance backlog, cause of failures, and ETA for restoration

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Decline
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints doubled THIS WEEK to 5 complaints versus a baseline average of 2.2 per week—a 122% spike with z-score of 4.16—raising concerns about mold, ventilation, or indoor pollutants in residential buildings during a period when residents may be relying on closed heating systems.
evidence: 5 indoor air quality complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.16)
122% increase coincides with heating season onset when buildings are sealed
Complements sustained high volume of heat/hot water complaints (3,971 over 90 days), suggesting systemic building issues
reporting_angles: Interview residents who filed complaints to understand whether mold, ventilation, or heating system issues are root cause
Cross-reference with heat/hot water complaints to identify buildings with overlapping complaints suggesting systemic HVAC problems

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Service Gap
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints exploded THIS LAST WEEK to 5 complaints versus a near-zero baseline of 0.1 per week—a stunning 3900% spike with z-score of 14.74—indicating either a sudden sanitation service failure or community awareness of a long-neglected issue now reaching critical mass.
evidence: 5 street sweeping complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 14.74, highest z-score in dataset)
3900% increase is statistically extreme, suggesting either service interruption or viral complaint trigger
Aligns with 'Dirty Condition' complaints up 95% last week (32 vs. 16.4 baseline) and 'Street Condition' complaints up 536% this week
reporting_angles: Check with Sanitation Department for missed schedules, equipment breakdowns, or staffing issues last week
Visit 5 specific complaint locations to assess actual debris accumulation and determine if complaints are new or backlog

themes_detail.label: Illegal Animal Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal animal-as-pet complaints jumped to 3 last week versus a baseline average of 0.1 per week—a 2300% increase with z-score of 8.69—suggesting either enforcement action targeting exotic/dangerous animal ownership or emerging community safety concern requiring rapid investigation.
evidence: 3 illegal animal complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.69)
2300% increase from near-zero baseline indicates either new problem or sudden enforcement push
Type of animals and specific locations unknown—requires drill-down investigation
reporting_angles: Obtain details on the 3 complaints: what animals, where, any injuries or threats to safety?
Interview NYPD or Animal Care and Control to understand if there was recent enforcement action or known dangerous animal issue
